words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah in dependency: the future seeing is not a detached prediction but a consequence of the preceding oath-and-character declaration in 68:1-4. It carries both sequence and causal pressure, moving the listener from settled description in 68:4 into promised disclosure in 68:5. Because it is fused to the following future-marked verb, the relation and the timing arrive together as {{ar:فَسَتُبْصِرُ}} ({{tr:fa-sa-tubṣiru}}): consequence first, then futurity, then the perception root.

topics.headline: fused onset with future marker

topics.reason: The surface form visibly joins {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) to the following future-marked verb, supporting the CRITICAL claims about stacked proclitics and recited liaison.

words.prose: {{ar:سَتُبْصِرُ}} ({{tr:sa-tubṣiru}}) places the addressee in the first witness position: the future marker is written on this verb, the 2ms subject is carried by the verb, and no object is stated. That objectlessness matters because 68:6 supplies the comparative content, so the word opens a slot that the reader must carry forward. The root field is not bare eyesight only; sight, discernment, and proof-language converge, with self-witness language elsewhere in the root field (75:14) sharpening the sense that perception becomes evidence. Still, the local form keeps the meaning as coming to perceive rather than seeking insight, teaching another, or reflective deliberation. As the first audible beat of a mirrored pair, it establishes the root, form, future frame, and singular addressee before the plural opponents receive the matching verb.

topics.headline: objectless seeing points to 68:6

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that binds the two perception clauses without making the second a consequence of the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the second seeing coordinate with the first. The particle does not restart the sentence and does not make the opponents' perception the result of the addressee's perception; it holds both verbs inside one shared event-frame. At the same time, it preserves the contrast between subjects: singular addressee first, plural opponents second. Because it is attached directly to {{ar:يُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:yubṣirūna}}), the coordination is not a pause before their clause but the very onset of their entry into the matched perception frame.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as coordination between the two verbal clauses.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle hold equality of perception-form together with opposition between the addressee and the plural group.
topics.reason: The coordinated verbs share the same root and form while their subject agreement differs, preserving the CRITICAL subject-contrast payoff.

topics.reason: The written and recited form attaches {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) directly to the following verb, supporting the CRITICAL form and liaison claims.

words.prose: {{ar:يُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:yubṣirūna}}) gives the same Form IV perception verb to the plural opposing side. Its 3mp morphology makes them grammatically present without naming them, so the threat stays indirect while the group is still gathered into one collective witness-position. The verb has no stated object, just like the first one, and because it closes the ayah that unresolved slot pushes into 68:6 for the disclosed content. Its future sense is inherited through coordination with {{ar:سَتُبْصِرُ}} ({{tr:sa-tubṣiru}}), not restarted by a second future prefix. The shared root field turns their coming perception into exposure before evidence-bearing clarity, with proof-language elsewhere in the root field (6:104) reinforcing the point without replacing the local sense. The final position matters: the ayah lands on the opponents' perception, and the longer plural cadence with the repeated root cluster makes the same verb-form that first promises vindication close as confrontation.

topics.headline: plural opponents encoded morphologically
topics.summary: The 3mp prefix and ending carry the opposing group inside the verb without an overt subject noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents are grammatically present as a plural witness-group even though the ayah does not name them here.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify 3mp agreement with no explicit same-ayah subject noun, supporting the CRITICAL focus on encoded collective subjecthood.

topics.headline: final objectless seeing
topics.summary: The second verb also leaves the object unstated, and its closing position intensifies the need to read into 68:6.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end with the object still missing, forcing the question in 68:6 to resolve what both parties will see.
topics.reason: The verb is marked with no stated object, and the attachment guidance explicitly warns that 68:6 supplies the compressed content.

topics.headline: future inherited through coordination
topics.summary: The second verb lacks its own future prefix, so its future force depends on coordination with the first verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second future is structurally dependent on the first rather than beginning a new timeline.
topics.reason: QAC states that future sense for the second verb comes from context, and attachment evidence makes the coordination with the first verb explicit.

topics.headline: same perception field becomes exposure
topics.summary: The shared sight-insight-proof field gives the opponents evidentiary exposure, while local grammar keeps the verb as finite future perception.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents receive the same evidentiary clarity as exposure, not just a neutral visual act.
topics.reason: V4 supports sight and inner-sight/proof branches for {{ar:ب ص ر}} ({{tr:b-ṣ-r}}), but formal branch range is narrowed to the local future perception verb; the proof-language recurrence at 6:104 is retained as supporting resonance.

topics.headline: clarity arrives, not sought
topics.summary: Form IV presents the opponents as coming to perceive what is disclosed, not as reflective seekers of insight.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents are not portrayed as initiating a search for clarity; clarity reaches them as a disclosed perception.
topics.reason: The local word is Form IV, so the CRITICAL contrasts with seeking or reflective stems survive as form-specific boundaries.

topics.headline: same verb-form, opposed roles
topics.summary: The second verb completes the mirrored structure by repeating the first verb's root and form with a changed subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one verb-form bind both sides of the dispute while person and number turn equality of form into confrontation.
topics.reason: The two coordinated verbs share root and Form IV while differing in subject agreement, so the CRITICAL mirror-and-reversal payoff is strongly licensed.

topics.headline: ayah closes on opponent perception
topics.summary: Closure position, longer plural cadence, and repeated root sound make the opponents' perception the ayah's final pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land on the opponents' seeing, with the plural cadence and repeated root cluster holding the confrontation open.
topics.reason: The word is the final verb of the ayah, repeats the perception root, and participates in the same-surah eye/perception thread at 68:43 and 68:51 while also carrying the prior magnitude forward from 68:4.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future-marked second-person singular verb and coordinated third-person plural verb repeat the same Form IV ب ص ر root.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same act of sight is distributed across opposed grammatical positions. The conjunction joins but does not merge them, staging a future disclosure available from both sides while preserving distinct standpoints.

activation_trace.role: Literal ocular seeing anchors both repeated verbs; distributing it across two subjects makes the disclosure bilateral.

changed_reading.before: You and they will each see something later.
changed_reading.after: One future disclosure enters the visual field of opposed parties without collapsing their standpoints into agreement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The objectless repetition of ب ص ر permits both verbs to activate the root's inward as well as ocular register.
baseline_models.mechanism: The future event is not exhausted by retinal access: each side can arrive at penetrative recognition, verification, or self-witness. Their recognitions may be parallel in time yet unequal in content and consequence.

activation_trace.role: The inward-sight branch supplies knowledge, verification, and self-witness, turning doubled seeing into eventual recognition.

changed_reading.before: Both parties will visually observe an unspecified event.
changed_reading.after: Both parties will be brought to recognition, though shared access need not yield symmetric judgment or response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing and lined inscription establish public claims, while the madness label images a covered mind and character names inward disposition. Future seeing can adjudicate between what is publicly written or alleged and what the person inwardly is.

activation_trace.role: Inward sight anchors the focus as eventual verification of a reality not exhausted by public labels.
The prepared writing instrument supplies inscription as a durable public claim that future sight can test.
The aligned written line gives public claims visible order and makes legibility part of the mechanism.
The branch of reason being covered supplies the accusation's model of hidden or disabled interior perception.
Inward disposition supplies the concealed reality against which the public diagnosis is eventually checked.

structural_cues: 68:1-4 move from writing and lined material to a diagnosis of covered reason and then to inward disposition immediately before 68:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, a mind-covering accusation, and inward character; I supply the arrow that future inner sight adjudicates their competing legibility. Alternatively, these may be adjacent affirmations and the seeing may concern only a later event.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises an unspecified future perception.
changed_reading.after: The verse promises a future evidentiary encounter in which public labels and inward character become distinguishable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unresolved question of which side is under assay is followed by discrimination between deviation and guidance. Seeing becomes the result-display of a test: both sides encounter disclosure, but disclosure sorts rather than equalizes them.

activation_trace.role: Inner verification anchors the doubled seeing as recognition of what the test has disclosed.
Assaying metal or a person supplies a process whose function is to make an initially disputed condition appear.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the discrimination that converts raw seeing into an assessed result.
Deviation from intended direction supplies one outcome exposed by the assay.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the contrasting outcome, making disclosure classificatory.

structural_cues: 68:6 leaves the tested party as an unresolved alternative, while 68:7 places final discrimination outside the two disputing sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assay, an unresolved either-side question, and contrasted trajectories; I infer that future sight displays the assay's result. The alternative is temporal adjacency without a test-to-disclosure arrow.

changed_reading.before: Bilateral seeing suggests a roughly symmetric future observation.
changed_reading.after: Bilateral seeing is the public result of an assay that reveals unequal trajectories and defeats the symmetry of the dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desired reciprocal accommodation tries to smooth the conflict's surface; the later future-marking construction places an involuntary sign on a conspicuous facial locus. Seeing shifts from passive observation to social legibility produced when managed appearance fails.

activation_trace.role: Literal sight anchors the model in what opposed parties can no longer keep visually ambiguous.
Soft accommodation and social smoothing supply the attempted management of how the opposition appears.
The literal nose or snout supplies a conspicuous facial surface on which concealed standing becomes publicly legible.

structural_cues: 68:9 repeats د ه ن across the two sides, formally echoing the doubled sight of 68:5 but as desired mutual accommodation.
68:16 supplies و س م at word 1 as a future marking construction; its branch inventory is missing, so it is used only structurally and is not branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal accommodation, a future mark structurally, and a facial locus; I infer movement from managed surface to involuntary visibility. The mark may instead be solely punitive without revising seeing.

changed_reading.before: Both parties will eventually observe the same contested situation.
changed_reading.after: Attempts to smooth the dispute give way to a visible public sign: future seeing is forced legibility, not negotiated appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden episode runs a test through material transformation. Its owners first see, infer loss or misdirection, then identify deprivation and turn to mutual blame. Ocular access is only the first stage; recognition is corrigible and becomes self-implicating through sequence.

activation_trace.role: Ocular seeing anchors the initial encounter with an altered state before its meaning is correctly inferred.
A test that makes condition appear supplies the causal process behind the visible transformation.
Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the explicit recognition scene that tests how perception becomes understanding.
Loss of the sought thing supplies the owners' first, incomplete diagnosis of what sight presents.
Prevention and deprivation supply the corrected diagnosis after the initial visual misreading.
Deserved mutual blame shifts recognition from an external loss to implicated agency.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence 68:17, 68:26, 68:27, and 68:30 moves from test to sight, failed diagnosis, corrected diagnosis, and self-implicating response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies this ordered correction after an explicit seeing event; I infer that it models the semantic depth of future seeing in 68:5. Alternatively, the episode may be an analogy for trial without elaborating that verb.

changed_reading.before: Future sight delivers immediate and transparent knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Future sight begins a staged correction: seeing can first misclassify, then disclose deprivation, and finally turn into self-recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judgment is followed by removal of covering, yet the exposed party's eyes are lowered while humiliation overtakes them. Grammatical reciprocity therefore does not guarantee equal visual agency: all may face the event while one side's sight is itself subordinated.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 sequence unveiling, summons and inability, then describe the eyes as lowered while humiliation covers their bearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unveiling and explicitly constrained eyes; I infer that this scene realizes one possible form of 68:5's reciprocity. It could instead be a separate later scene, leaving 68:5 more general.

changed_reading.after: Both sides can be made to see while only one retains an unbroken standpoint; exposure is shared, visual agency is not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking operates under present nonrecognition, while time is deliberately extended and the process remains firm. The focus's future prefix is not mere postponement: delay is the medium through which the visible result is produced.

activation_trace.role: Eventual inner recognition anchors the endpoint that a presently unnoticed process can generate.
Taking by degrees supplies an incremental mechanism rather than a single abrupt disclosure.
Disclosure to the knower, negated in the source construction, supplies present nonrecognition against which future sight changes.
Extension of time and respite supply the temporal room in which the degrees accumulate.
Extended firmness supplies continuity, making delay an active process rather than inactivity.

structural_cues: 68:44 joins gradual action to a negative knowledge clause, and 68:45 immediately adds first-person temporal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies degrees, nonrecognition, extension, and firmness; I supply the arrow that delay builds the disclosure promised by future seeing. Alternatively, delay may merely postpone an independently caused outcome.

changed_reading.before: The future marker means only that seeing has not happened yet.
changed_reading.after: The interval before seeing is causally loaded: unnoticed degrees and extended time mature into eventual disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim to possess and write the unseen is answered by an imperative to restrain the addressed self under judgment. The singular side of the focus is not licensed to force present visibility; future seeing entails disciplined waiting rather than speculative closure.

activation_trace.role: Verified inner sight anchors knowledge promised later rather than claimed prematurely.

structural_cues: 68:47 frames their position as possession of the unseen and writing it; 68:48 switches to a singular imperative of patience under judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present hiddenness, speculative writing, restraint, and judgment; I infer that future sight requires withholding premature closure. Patience may instead concern endurance alone without an epistemic role.

changed_reading.after: The promise imposes epistemic restraint now: genuine sight is awaited under judgment rather than replaced by writing the unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later context makes plural eyes the instrument of nearly moving the singular addressee off his footing. Reciprocal seeing enters an agonistic field: their gaze is directional action, and promised bilateral disclosure can be read as a reversal that exposes the attempted dislodgers.

activation_trace.role: Literal sight anchors the opposed subjects in a shared visual field whose vectors need not be passive.

Their literal eyes supply the instrument that turns vision from reception into attempted displacement.

structural_cues: 68:51 grammatically attaches the plural eyes to near-dislodging and repeats the singular-versus-plural opposition of 68:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an instrumental gaze and near-loss of footing; I infer that earlier future reciprocity reverses this vector by exposing those who try to dislodge. Alternatively, 68:51 may be an idiom of hostile looking without literal causal force.

changed_reading.after: Seeing is a contested force between singular and plural sides; future disclosure reverses who can destabilize whom.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Singular and plural sight form opposed positions later reactivated when plural eyes nearly dislodge the singular addressee.

activation_trace.role: The shining shield or worn-defense branch supplies an exploratory model of protected exposure within visual conflict.
The same defensive branch at the hostile eyes makes armor a relational response to optical aggression rather than an isolated gloss.
Loss of footing supplies the force against which the visual position is imagined as needing defense.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is receptive awareness of what happens.
changed_reading.after: Seeing also marks a defended or exposed position inside an attempted optical assault.

strongest_changes: The assay and garden sequence turn bilateral sight into tested, corrigible recognition rather than simultaneous neutral observation.
The unveiling and humbled-eyes sequence breaks any equation between shared exposure and equal visual agency.
Stepwise delay makes future disclosure an accumulated result, while near-dislodging gaze makes sight an active and reversible force.
summary.what_was_special: A two-verb, one-root focus remained unusually generative because context repeatedly changed the function of seeing without supplying its object: inscription versus interior, assay, public marking, mistaken recognition, unequal capacity, delay, restraint, and optical force coexist rather than collapse into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The omitted object leaves several context realizations live; the packet does not force one scene.
Inner sight may be lexically active in 68:5 or arise only as the consequence of ocular disclosure.
The joined-edge, visible-residue, and optical-armor models are branch-distant analogies and require the stated containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reciprocal sight as future verification.** Both verbs activate `ب ص ر B001`; their balanced syntax gives the addressee and opponents the same future act of seeing. The delayed *fa-sa-* makes events, rather than present allegation, the verifier. I infer unfolding consequence -> shared visibility; the ayah promises an evidentiary disclosure that neither side can keep private.
2. **Insight divided despite common vision.** `ب ص ر B002` supplies inner sight and proof. Later 68:26 shows the garden owners seeing and correcting their account, while 68:43 presents lowered eyes under abasement. This sequence distinguishes visual encounter from interpretive penetration. I infer that the same disclosure can yield insight or compelled recognition; the ayah preserves both bodily seeing and inward discernment without collapsing them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:26 supplied a miniature fulfillment in which seeing first produces confusion and then insight. 68:43 and 68:51 made the bodily politics of sight more surprising: eyes can be lowered by disclosure or used aggressively to destabilize another.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seeing as convergent understanding.** Both fixed verbs activate `ب ص ر B002` (inner sight, certainty, and self-witness). The surrounding writing in 68:1, tested identity in 68:6, and knowledge/path contrast in 68:7 supply objects for interpretation; I infer that the future event converts contested signs into inward recognition for both sides. The doubled verb therefore promises epistemic disclosure, not only ocular observation.
2. **A future seam joining two opposed panels.** The same root activates `ب ص ر B006` (the thick joined edge between panels). The exact repetition `تُبْصِرُ / يُبْصِرُونَ` joined by `و` supplies two grammatically parallel sides; I infer that one disclosed outcome binds otherwise opposed perspectives at a shared edge. The ayah reads as a point of forced comparison where “you” and “they” finally meet.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:6-7 gave the paired sight a specific object: an assayed identity and a distinction between courses. This corrected an initially visual reading toward fixed `ب ص ر B002`, shared recognition under one diagnostic outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Covers Regulate Access to Sight and Interior Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seeing and knowing depend on whether a physical, mental, or social cover protects, obscures, or reveals what lies within.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge of madness is reframed as an argument about covered interiors: eye-films, shields, shelters, ribs, and unspoken thought all test what observers can legitimately infer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, Insight, and the Film That Defeats Both
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An eye opens onto a visible object, inward discernment interprets it, and a woven film or disappearance can interrupt both perception and retention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ocular sight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); eye-film like a web (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`); hidden disappearance (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); loss from memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); cognition as disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:5 `تُبْصِرُ`/`يُبْصِرُ` [ب ص ر]; 68:7 `سَبِيلِ` [س ب ل], `ضَلَّ` [ض ل ل], and `أَعْلَمُ` [ع ل م].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Perception proceeds from open eye to inward verification. The eye-film, disappearance, and failed memory show three distinct ways that evidence can cease to be available, sharpening the contrast between human seeing and divine knowing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Leather, cloth, armor, and a screened place interpose a fitted layer between a vulnerable occupant and exterior force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); worn armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); tent-like insect screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`); leather shelter or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment is not only epistemic failure. The same invariant produces armor, shelter, and screened habitation, so a cover can preserve a life even as another cover prevents an observer from seeing truly.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority is enacted by keeping charge, binding parties, directing motion, or deciding whether restraint continues.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lordship, contract, bridle-like obedience, coercive hauling, and release from captivity occupy one field of controlled attachment without being reduced to one moral value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Arms, Captivity, and Uncompensated Release
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Shield, cutting weapon, spear-part, and heavy tool produce capture; authority may then release the captive without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m02`); armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m02`); sword-cut or butcher’s blade (`quranic:root_000704:B004/m01`); pared spear-tip or shaft (`quranic:root_001252:B005/m01`); crowbar or heavy club (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m01`); release of a captive without exchange (`quranic:root_001449:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The martial scene keeps protection, violence, custody, and release distinct. Its unexpected pressure on “uninterrupted reward” is that `م ن ن` can also name the sovereign interruption of captivity without a compensating payment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rock Pool, Oil Basin, and Deep Water Store
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Natural and made depressions catch water; their stone edges and depth determine whether the collected resource remains available.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rainwater caught in a rock hollow (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); oil vessel or mountain pool (`quranic:root_000497:B005/m01`); sea or water-rich well (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); abundant collected water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m02`); soft pale basin-stone (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision is stored by topology: hollow, vessel, well, and stone rim. This compact hydrological mechanism usefully pressures the language of favor by showing the material infrastructure through which water becomes durable benefit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitched Leather Stretches Across a Wooden Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Poles, ribs, and saddle wood support a fitted leather or cloth cover whose seams create a protected interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: carrying frame or tent poles (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); leather dome or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m02`); ribs and house-posts (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m02`); saddle wood (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m02`); protective screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m02`); joining two hides or cloth panels (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The shelter is a distributed assembly: frame, posts, saddle wood, cover, and seam. Its coherence rests on fitted tension, giving the pericope a concrete model for how separate parts become a protective whole.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda vurgu anlayışın keskinliği ve hızı üzerindedir; bu dalda bilgiye dayanan iç açıklık ve delil boyutu belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kavrayışın aydınlatıcı bilgi ve delil yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişiyi uygunsuz olandan alıkoyan akıl ve iç engel yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iç idrak alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bilip doğrulamayı anlatır; komşu ise aklın sınırlayıcı ve koruyucu işlevini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Öncelik aynı kökün gözle görme dalına ve yakın zihinsel alan adaylarına verildi. Diğer adaylar bilgi, şüphe veya araştırma alanında daha uzak kaldığı için ayrı yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم بالشيء ونفاذ القلب والمعرفة والتحقق والاستبصار في الدين والحجة والعبرة وشهادة الإنسان على نفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حاسة العين ولا اللمعان الحسي ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yalnızca ışıklı oluşa indirmez; aydınlatan, açık kılan, kendisiyle görülen veya insanları görür hale getiren işlevleri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dal kabul edilebilir, fakat tanım hem aydınlık hem de açıklayıcı işlevi birlikte taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görmeyi veya anlamayı mümkün kılan açıklıkla sınırlıdır; göz organı ya da yalın iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin aydınlatıcı ve açıklayıcı işlevini verir; kalıba bağlı ayrı bir anlam genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin aydınlık, açık veya açıklayıcı olup görmeyi ya da anlamayı mümkün kılması. Bu alan, işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesiyle tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Aydınlatıcı veya açık kılıcı nitelik, görmeyi ve anlamayı mümkün kılar.
Bir işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesi bu çekirdeğin nedensel uzantısıdır.
Açıklama ve belirgin kılma eylemi aynı alan içinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda aydınlık, açıklık, kendisiyle görülme ve insanları görür hale getirme yönlerini bir araya getirir. Ayrıca açıklama ve belirgin kılma anlamı aynı toplu iddiada desteklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ışıkla görünür kılmayı hem de açık seçik gösterme işlevini birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Aydınlatma, açıklık ve görmeyi veya kavramayı mümkün kılma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işaretin anlamı belirgin kılması bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Açıklık ve gösterme işlevini korur.
Işık ve görünürlük yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Açıklayıcı delil ve insanı kavrar hale getirme yönlerini daraltır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: aydınlık, açık kılan ve görmeyi sağlayan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal aydınlığın açıklayıcı ve görmeyi sağlayıcı işlevini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ışık ve nurun kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de görünürlük ve aydınlık alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu ışık olgusuna odaklanır; bu dal ışığın veya açıklığın bir şeyi görülür ve anlaşılır hale getirmesine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal aydınlatma veya açıklama yoluyla görmeyi mümkün kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gizlilikten sonra ortaya çıkma ve dışa vurulmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de belirginlik ve açıklık vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirginliği sağlayan aydınlatıcı işlevi taşır; komşuda odak şeyin görünür biçimde ortaya çıkmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal görmeyi sağlayan açıklık veya işarettir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal göz organı, görme duyusu ve görme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi görme alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal algının nesnesindeki veya işaretindeki açıklığı anlatır; komşu algılayan göz ve eylem tarafını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aydınlık, ortaya çıkma ve aynı kökün gözle görme dalı sınırı en kullanışlı ayrımları sağladı. Diğer adaylar biçim, açık oluş veya yorum alanlarında daha dolaylı kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه عين الإنسان نفسها ولا العلم المجرد عن إظهار أو إضاءة ولا حجارة البصرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المبصرة المضيئة تبصرهم أي تجعلهم بصراء والمبصرة بالفتح الحجة (sihah)؛ مبصرة مضيئة وتبين لهم ومبصرا بها (tahdhib)؛ آياتنا مبصرة أي مضيئة للأبصار وقيل صار أهله بصراء وتبصرة أي تبصيرا وتبيانا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kanın yerdeki yuvarlak parçası, bedendeki yolları, izi, küçük miktarı ve şiirde kan bedeli veya öç bağlamı olarak verir. Dalın kimliği kan lekesi veya kan izi alanıdır; iç kavrayış ve silah anlamları yalnızca eş adlı başka dallardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kan parçası, izi, lekesi ve buna bağlı şiirsel kan bedeli veya öç kullanımıdır; göz ve bilgi alanı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kan parçası ve izi anlamını verir; başka dallardaki eş adlı kullanımlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yere veya bedene düşen kan parçası, kan lekesi ya da kan izi; bağlama göre bu izden hareketle kan bedeli veya öç konusu da anılır. Çekirdek, somut kan kalıntısı ve onun izleyici işaret oluşudur.

facets.statement: Yerde veya bedende görülen kan parçası, leke ya da iz çekirdektir.
Yerde yuvarlaklaşan veya parlayan küçük kan miktarı özel olarak belirtilir.
Kan izi, yaralanmayı veya atışı gösteren bir belirti olarak kullanılabilir.
Şiirsel kullanımlarda kan bedeli, kan davası veya öç anlamı bu kan alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak iddiası bu dalı somut kan izi ve kan parçası olarak kurar: yerdeki parça, bedendeki yol veya yarayı gösteren belirti. Aynı toplu iddia şiir bağlamında kan bedeli ve öç bağlantılarını da çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kan parçası, leke, yerdeki veya bedendeki kan yolu çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Somut kan kalıntısı ve işaret oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yere veya bedene düşmüş görünen kan parçası anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Somut kan parçası ve leke yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İzden sonuç çıkarma ve şiirsel kan bedeli uzantısını daraltır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şiir veya öç bağlamında kanın karşılığı ya da hesabı anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlı hukukî veya şiirsel uzantıyı korur.
error_profile.loses: Somut kan lekesi çekirdeğini tek başına karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yerde veya bedende kan lekesi, kan izi

error_profile.preserves: Aynı kökün başka dalına ait bir anlamı korur.
error_profile.loses: Somut kan parçası, leke ve iz anlamını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bilgi ve kalp idraki alanı ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle kan parçası, kan lekesi veya kan izidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir şeyin az miktarı veya küçük parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de parça veya az miktar fikri vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu miktar bakımından geneldir; bu dal kan maddesine ve onun iz oluşuna bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kan izi veya kanın şiirsel hesabıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ceza yerine ödenen diyet ve onu üstlenen topluluk düzenidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de öldürme veya yaralama sonrası kan hesabı alanına değebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal somut izden ve şiirsel öçten hareket eder; komşu hukuki ödeme ve sorumluluk sistemini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kan parçası ve izidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalkan, zırh veya giyilen savaş gerecidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi savaş veya yaralanma sahnesinde bulunabilir ve aynı yüzey biçimini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kan maddesine bağlıdır; komşu koruyucu savaş nesnesini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayımlanan ayrımlar somut parça, kan hesabı ve aynı kökün silah dalıyla karışma ihtimalini kapsar. Diğer adaylar renk, yerde iz veya kanın boşa gitmesi gibi daha uzak bağlantılar verdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصيرة من الدم: القطعة أو الطريقة أو المقدار على الأرض أو الجسد، وما اتصل بها من ثأر أو دية في الشعر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصيرة القلب ولا الترس والدرع إلا من جهة اشتراك اللفظ أو التشبيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصيرة القطعة من الدم إذا وقعت بالأرض استدارت (maqayis;jamhara)؛ بصائر الدماء طرائقها على الجسد (ayn)؛ البصيرة من الدم ما كان على الأرض وشيء من الدم يستدل به على الرمية (sihah)؛ بصيرة من دم والجدية منها على الأرض والبصيرة الدية ومقدار الدرهم من الدم (tahdhib)؛ البصيرة قطعة من الدم تلمع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kalkan, zırh ve savaşta giyilen koruyucu donanım anlamında toplar. Bazı ifadelerde parlaklık veya şiir tanıklığı bulunsa da dalın çekirdeği koruyucu silah nesnesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kalkan, zırh ve giyilen savaş korumasıdır; kan lekesi, iç kavrayış ve kumaş dikişi anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın koruyucu savaş nesnesi anlamını verir; başka eş adlı dallar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Savaşta korunmak için kullanılan kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu silah donanımı. Parlaklık ya da şiirsel tanıklık, nesnenin kendisine bağlı ayrıntıdır.

facets.statement: Kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu savaş nesnesi çekirdektir.
Kaynaklar kalkan ile zırh arasında değişen adlandırmalar verir, fakat ikisi de koruyucu silah alanındadır.
Parlak kalkan niteliği nesnenin olası betimleyici yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası bu dalı koruyucu savaş gereci olarak verir: kalkan, zırh veya giyilen silah. Kalkan ile zırh arasındaki farklı adlandırma çekirdek alanı değiştirmez; hepsi koruma nesnesi çerçevesindedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kalkan, zırh ve giyilen savaş korumasını tek başlıkta toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma amacı, savaş bağlamı ve nesne türünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynak veya bağlam özellikle elde taşınan koruyucu nesneyi düşündürdüğünde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Koruyucu savaş nesnesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Zırh ve giyilen silah kapsamını daraltır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz savaşta giyilen korumaya odaklandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Giyilen koruyucu savaş donanımını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kalkan, zırh veya giyilen savaş koruması

error_profile.preserves: Savaş sahnesine dolaylı olarak bağlanabilir.
error_profile.loses: Koruyucu nesne ve savaş donanımı anlamını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Kan maddesi ve leke anlamı ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kalkan ve zırh gibi savaş nesnelerine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal korunulan her örtü veya siper için daha genel olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de koruyucu nesne alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal savaş donanımıyla daha sınırlıdır; komşu korunma sağlayan nesne alanını daha geniş tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kalkanı da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle giyilen zırh veya savaş elbisesi yönündedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de savaşta korunmak için kullanılan donanımı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu giyilen korumaya daha dar bağlanır; bu dal kalkan ile zırh arasında değişen bir kapsam taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal koruyucu savaş nesnesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kan parçası, leke veya izidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi savaş veya yaralanma bağlamında yan yana görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne türüdür; komşu yaralanma sonucunda kalan kan maddesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Koruyucu savaş gereci için en keskin adaylar genel siper, zırh ve aynı kökün kan dalıdır. Diğer silah adayları alan ortaklığı verse de çekirdek ayrımı bu üçünden daha fazla netleşmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصيرة بمعنى الترس أو الدرع وكل ما لبس من السلاح إذا سمي بصائر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصيرة القلب ولا بقعة الدم ولا القطعة المخيطة من الثوب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصيرة الترس فيما يقال (maqayis)؛ البصيرة الدرع وما لبس من السلاح فهو بصائر السلاح (ayn;tahdhib)؛ البصيرة في هذا البيت الترس أو الدرع (sihah)؛ الترس اللامع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kalınlık, yan veya kenar, dış deri, iki deri parçasını dikme, ev veya elbise parçaları arasındaki şerit ve iki parçayı birleştiren yama malzemesini birlikte verir. Çekirdek, kenar-kalınlık ile parçaların birleştirilmesi alanında düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesnenin kalın kenarı, yanı ve iki parça arasını dikme veya birleştirme alanıdır; taş, göz ve iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kalın kenar ve birleştirici dikiş alanını verir; başka kalıplardan ek anlam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kalın dış yanı, kenarı veya yüzeyi ve iki deri, kumaş ya da kap parçasını bir araya getirip dikilen ara bölüm. Dal, kalın kenar fikri ile parçaları ek yerinden birleştirme fikrini aynı maddi yüzey alanında tutar.

facets.statement: Nesnenin kalın dış yanı, kenarı, yüzeyi veya yönü çekirdeğin bir bölümüdür.
İki deri, kumaş veya kap parçasının ek yerinden dikilip birleştirilmesi çekirdeğin diğer bölümüdür.
Çadır, elbise veya su kabı parçaları arasındaki şerit ya da bölüm bu birleştirme alanının özel nesnesidir.
İki parça arasında yamanmış veya eklenmiş şey aynı alanın sonuç nesnesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kalınlık, yan, kenar ve dış yüzey anlamlarını iki parça arasını dikme ve ek yeri nesnesiyle birlikte verir. Toplu iddia, çadır, elbise, deri ve su kabı gibi maddi örnekleri aynı kenar ve birleştirme alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nesnenin kalın dış yanını hem de iki parçanın dikildiği ara bölümü korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kenar, kalınlık, dış yüzey ve birleştirici dikiş çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz bir nesnenin yanı, dış yüzeyi veya kalın tarafı için kullanıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yan ve kenar yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Dikişle birleştirme ve ara parça yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya kap parçalarının birleştirildiği bölüm anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İki parçayı dikme, ara bölüm ve sonuç ek yerini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyin yanı, kenarı veya kalın dış yüzü
çadır, elbise veya kapta iki parça arası

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal beden veya şeyin yanı ve yakın çevresi alanında kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de yan ve kenar fikri bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel yan veya taraf adıdır; bu dal maddi kalınlık ve parçaları dikerek birleştirme yönünü de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrıca nesnenin kalın kenarı ve ara parçasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dikiş ve onarma eylemini daha genel anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de kumaş veya deriyi dikerek birleştirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dikiş eylemine odaklanır; bu dal dikişin oluşturduğu kenar, ara parça ve kalın yüzey alanını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kenar kalınlığı ve farklı maddelerdeki ara bölümü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki kumaşın kenarlarından bitiştirilmesine daha dar bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iki parçayı kenarlarından birleştirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu belirli bir birleşmiş kumaş sonucuna yakındır; bu dal daha geniş maddi kenar ve dikiş alanını kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kenar, dikiş ve ek yeri alanındaki en yakın adaylar yayımlandı. Diğer komşular kenar, örme veya çözme gibi tematik bağlar taşısa da temel sınırı daha iyi açıklamadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه غلظ الشيء وجلده أو جانبه وحرفه، وخياطة أديم إلى أديم أو ما بين شقتي البيت أو الثوب أو المزادة، والقطعة الملفقة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه حجارة البصرة الرخوة ولا حاسة البصر ولا بصيرة القلب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بصر الشيء غلظه والبصر هو أن يضم أديم إلى أديم يخاطان والبصيرة ما بين شقتي البيت (maqayis)؛ البصر غلظ الشيء نحو بصر الجبل والسماء والحائط (ayn)؛ بصر كل شيء جلده الظاهر وثوب ذو بصر إذا كان غليظا وثيجا (jamhara)؛ البصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم والبصر بالضم الجانب والحرف من كل شيء وغلظها (sihah)؛ الباصر الملفق بين شقتين والبصيرة الشقة التي تكون على الخباء والبصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم (tahdhib)؛ البصر الناحية والبصيرة ما بين شقتي الثوب والمزادة وبصرت الثوب والأديم إذا خطت ذلك الموضع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yumuşak, parlak veya beyaza çalan taşlar ve bu taşlı yer adıyla açıklar; ayrıca bu yer adına gitme kalıbı verilir. Dalın çekirdeği taş türü ve taşlı yerdir, başka yer adları veya nispetler dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taş ve bu taşlı yer anlamıdır; göz, iç kavrayış, dikiş ve dış yer adları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak taş ve taşlı yer anlamını temel alır; o yere gitme kalıbı bağlı kullanım olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar ve böyle taşları bulunan yer. Bu yer adından hareketle oraya gitme kullanımı çekirdeğe bağlı bir yönelme kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar çekirdektir.
Bu taşların bulunduğu arazi veya yer adı aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
Bu adla anılan yere varmak veya gitmek bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.
Kaynaklar yumuşaklık, parlaklık, beyazlık ve alçımsı arazi niteliklerini aynı taş alanında toplar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda yumuşak taş, parlak taş, beyaza çalan taş ve böyle taşlı arazi niteliklerini birleştirir. Aynı toplu iddia, bu taşlı yer adından türeyen oraya gitme kullanımını da bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taş türünün yumuşaklık, parlaklık ve beyazımsı görünüm niteliklerini kısa biçimde verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصرة والبصر بمعنى الحجارة الرخوة أو البراقة أو المائلة إلى البياض، والأرض المسماة بذلك، ومنه تسمية البصرة والإتيان إليها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصرى الشام ولا الأباصر ولا السيف البصري ولا بنصر الإصبع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصرة الحجارة الرخوة وبصر بكسر الباء من الأصل الثاني (maqayis)؛ البصرة أرض حجارتها جص والبصرة الحجارة التي فيها بعض اللين (ayn)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة وبه سميت البصرة (jamhara)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة إلى البياض وبصر بالكسر (sihah)؛ البصر والبصرة الحجارة البراقة وأرض كأنها جبل من جص وبصر الأرض غلظها وبصر فلان تبصيرا إذا أتى البصرة (tahdhib)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة تلمع ويقال له بصر (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çok dallıdır: gözle görme ve iç kavrayış gibi algı temelli dalların yanında açıklık, kan izi, koruyucu savaş gereci, kalın kenar-ek yeri ve yumuşak parlak taş anlamları bulunur. Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.
